versions.changelog:
Renesas Search v3.0.6

- Documentation updated in HERMES_INSTALL.md, README.md, and SKILL.md with tweaks to categories, tags, and author field.
- SKILL.md: metadata platform category changed from "research" to "hardware".
- Author field updated from "Peter (wangp-gh)" to "wangp-gh".
- LICENSE file was removed.
v3.0.5: Hermes Agent compatibility. Add metadata.hermes.category=research, tags, version, author, license, platforms to SKILL.md frontmatter. New HERMES_INSTALL.md with three install paths.

v3.0.4: add scenarios D (RA6M5 MCU), E (ISL88013 power management), F (obsolete part handling) to TEST_SCENARIOS.md. Total 6 test scenarios covering trigger rule, no-fabrication, typ-only reporting, MCU comparison, power management, and obsolete-part handling.
v3.0.3: add TEST_SCENARIOS.md — three runnable scenarios (A: trigger rule, B: no-fabrication, C: typ-only reporting) for clone-and-verify workflow.
v3.0.2: fix file path for references/product_families.md (was stored without 'references/' prefix in v3.0.0/3.0.1 due to multipart basename extraction).
